task.description:
Read git diff main...HEAD on this branch. This run had a security review flag one non-blocking observation worth your own idiom-lens attention too: PromotionDigest.compute_plan_digest/1's own docstring states its digest covers only plan.entries, not the full envelope, so verify_digest/2 alone doesn't protect target_tenant_id from tampering in isolation -- SECURITY-REVIEWER assessed this as pre-existing digest scope (unchanged by this diff) with no live exploitable path today (pre-S4, no API surface exists yet), not a blocking finding. Confirm you agree this is genuinely pre-existing and not newly introduced/newly exposed by this diff's changes to promotion.ex -- if this diff changed how target_tenant_id flows into the digest-checked path in a way that makes the pre-existing gap newly reachable, that would change the calculus.

Standard checks:
1. Decision-record consistency: decision 0006 section 6 states this requirement (D2) supersedes 0003 Dimension B's tenant_id-retention clause specifically. Confirm the diff's moduledoc updates (Engine.Task/TokenRecord, Identity.User/Group, the three EventStore modules) accurately describe the new state without contradicting 0003's still-standing parts (the schema-per-tenant isolation choice itself, Dimensions A and C).
2. Migration idiom: ten new drop-tenant_id migrations -- spot-check 2-3 for consistent shape (prefix() guard, ALTER TABLE ... DROP COLUMN, registered in tenant_scoped_migrations/0).
3. Scope creep: ELIXIR-DEV made 3 fixes beyond the design's own artifacts_in list (definitions.ex's two prefix-only queries, identity.ex's get_by_external_identity/3, promotion.ex's target_tenant_id source change, plus identity_migration.ex's fragment/2 changes). SECURITY-REVIEWER already cleared these for cross-tenant safety -- your job is idiom: are these genuinely necessary, minimal fixes forced by the column drops (as claimed), or did any of them do more than the minimum needed to keep the code compiling/functioning correctly?
4. Supervision integrity: confirm no supervision-tree file touched (this is schema/migration/query work, should be zero, verify rather than assume).
5. TokenRecord vs Token: spot-check that the diff correctly touched Engine.TokenRecord and left Engine.Token (REQ-044's separate in-memory struct) alone.
acceptance_criteria: Decision-record consistency confirmed: moduledoc updates accurate, no contradiction of 0003's standing parts
Migration idiom spot-checked against 2-3 of the ten new migrations
The 4 beyond-design fixes evaluated as minimal/necessary, not scope creep
No supervision-tree file touched, confirmed not assumed
TokenRecord/Token distinction correctly maintained in the diff
The PromotionDigest scope observation confirmed genuinely pre-existing, not newly exposed by this diff
